role: The Nether chunk pipeline: ChunkProviderHell's construction (noise order), density pass (initializeNoiseField plus func_147419_a interpolation into netherrack and the y<32 lava sea), surface pass (func_147418_b: soul sand, gravel, bedrock floor and roof), and MapGenCavesHell's carver over the 8-chunk range.

structs.name: hell_cave
structs.java: MapGenBase's per-call chunk coordinates and Block[] target, as MapGenCavesHell sees them

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
lines 348-411, function hell_tunnel: recursive (each branch point calls hell_tunnel twice); depth bounded in practice by width > 1.0f halving but not by a fixed limit
line 96, function nether_field: libm cos stands in for StrictMath.cos; exactness depends on the platform libm, which a GPU math library may not match
notes: Runs inside the tick only when world.c load_dim_chunk generates a Nether chunk on demand (world.c reseeds nether.rand per chunk before nether_terrain). The Nether fortress (MapGenNetherBridge) and ChunkProviderHell.populate are not here: they live in features_nether.c and structure code (not verified here). Block ids only; metas stay zero.
